show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Katrina Lake – The Next Wave of E-Commerce - [Invest Like the Best, EP.187]

reader_summary.headline: Bottomless is a smart coffee subscription which automatically reorders coffee for you based on your consumption habits.
reader_summary.overview: Bottomless is a smart coffee subscription which automatically reorders coffee for you based on your consumption habits. You may remember Bottomless from Episode 124 when we had co-founder and CEO Michael Mayer on the show. I'm also a bottomless customer and like the service and ideas so much I became an investor.

key_points.text: They send you a complimentary Wi-Fi scale with your first coffee order.
key_points.evidence_quote: They send you a complimentary Wi-Fi scale with your first coffee order.

key_points.text: Just set up a scale with your Wi-Fi, store your coffee on top, and then from that point forward.
key_points.evidence_quote: Just set up a scale with your Wi-Fi, store your coffee on top, and then from that point forward, bottomless sends you coffee at the perfect time with no additional effort.

key_points.text: The coffee itself is always roasted to order and shipped straight to you from a network of roasters across the country.
key_points.evidence_quote: The coffee itself is always roasted to order and shipped straight to you from a network of roasters across the country.

key_points.text: My favorite part about Bottomless is how the technology could be used for almost anything I buy regularly.
key_points.evidence_quote: My favorite part about Bottomless is how the technology could be used for almost anything I buy regularly.

thesis: Katrina Lake argues that the first wave of e-commerce focused on price, assortment, and convenience through search and filter models, which fail to solve the core problem of helping consumers find items they specifically love because the sheer volume of options makes narrowing down choices nearly impossible. She posits that the next wave of e-commerce is defined by personalization that addresses the emotional need to identify clothes that fit and resonate with the individual, a capability that traditional brick-and-mortar advantages like location are no longer able to provide.
